blocks.title: Project timeline
blocks.text: Project ki timelines tay karne ka matlab yeh faisla hai ke project ka har hissa kitna waqt lega. Is se project apni raah par rehta aur waqt par mukammal hota hai.

blocks.title: Misal
blocks.text: Agar aap website bana rahe hain to site design karne ki ek timeline, content likhne ki doosri aur sab kuch test karne ki teesri rakh sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Timeline project ki kaise madad karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Har hisse ka waqt tay kar ke yeh jaldi dikha deti hai ke project peeche to nahi reh raha, to team qadam utha kar phir bhi waqt par mukammal kar sakti hai.

items: Timelines: har hissa kitna waqt lega; project ko raah par aur waqt par rakhti hain (website: design, content, testing).
